scientific_question: Can independently measured Or56a/DA2 biology and audited downstream wiring reproduce known geosmin-channel phenomena without fitting to the later odor-conflict or navigation benchmarks?
success_interpretation: O001 may establish that the evidence assembly and calibration reproduce known specialist-channel observations within uncertainty. It does not establish a connectome advantage for odor detection and cannot support the O003/O004 headline claim.
failure_interpretation: Failure blocks downstream mechanistic use of the O001 parameterization. Do not fit O003/O004 behavior to repair O001.
promotion_rule: A new version is required for any change informed by downstream performance.
